question: Identify the first 10 words, sorted alphabetically, that are 4 to 5 characters long, start with 'r', and have at least one anagram of the same length, considering case-sensitive letters. Provide the count of such anagrams for each word.
sql:
WITH r_words AS (
  SELECT 
    words,
    string_agg(c, '' ORDER BY c) as sorted_key
  FROM word_list, unnest(split(words, '')) as t(c)
  WHERE words LIKE 'r%' AND LENGTH(words) BETWEEN 4 AND 5
  GROUP BY words
),
anagram_groups AS (
  SELECT sorted_key, COUNT(*) as anagram_count
  FROM r_words
  GROUP BY sorted_key
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT rw.words, ag.anagram_count, rw.sorted_key
FROM r_words rw
JOIN anagram_groups ag ON rw.sorted_key = ag.sorted_key
ORDER BY rw.words
LIMIT 10
